winner.purpose: The winner's total on the winner screen. Tabular; shrinks to fit, down to 0.4 and never below 12 pixels.

hull.purpose: Team totals in the lockup. Tabular; shrinks to fit; both drop to Display size past four digits, and to Field size on a short screen.

display.purpose: Winner heading and the other team's total on the winner screen; the totals of a finished match; the name on the champion slab; the winner's total in the compact winner screen.

field.purpose: Text typed into a number field. Tabular. Team totals on a short screen.

title.purpose: Target value, team name field and text field, sheet and screen titles, empty-state headings, winner sentence, team name on a seat slab, figures of a ranking. On a short screen also number-field text, the winner heading, the other team's total and the name on the champion slab.

button.purpose: Slab labels, team names, points in row chips, the two player fields, section headings of a screen, names waiting their turn; the winner sentence on a short screen.

body.purpose: Full sentences only: explanations, field messages, undo message. Upright. Text actions use this size in 800 italic capitals, underlined; the players line on the champion slab uses it in 600 italic capitals.

meta.purpose: Points remaining and rounds chip inside a livery; the header's status line; wins chip and players line on a seat slab; the Ganador chip; role and wins lines on the champion slab; the team name on a livery on a short screen.

label.purpose: Field labels, group labels, column heads and hand numbers; the players line under a team name; dates, the number of a match inside its tournament, summaries and the facts line of a screen. Weight 800 on the hand number of the newest and the selected row, and on the En juego line of a ranking row.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: --ease-out. The curve of every authored movement.

motion.name: row-enter
motion.purpose: A new hand streaks in from its team's side.

motion.name: total-pop
motion.purpose: A team total snaps when it changes.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: A sheet rises from the bottom edge and leaves the same way.

motion.name: screen-slide
motion.value: 220ms translateX from 24% with opacity from 0 (opacity ease-out)
motion.purpose: A full screen arrives from the right and leaves the same way.

motion.name: screen-flood
motion.purpose: The colour of the champion's side floods a toned screen, as the winner flood does.

motion.name: winner-flood
motion.value: 220ms translateX from -160vw (left side) or 160vw (right side); content opacity 220ms ease-out after 60ms
motion.purpose: The winning colour floods the screen.

motion.name: undo-rise
motion.purpose: The undo bar arrives over the list.

motion.name: hover
motion.value: filter brightness(1.12) on slabs, rows and list entries, brightness(1.06) on liveries and seat slabs; only under (hover: hover)

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: All movement is declared inside prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference. Under reduced motion surfaces appear in their final state and the list jumps to the end instead of scrolling smoothly.

motion.name: haptics
motion.value: vibrate 15ms on a hand; [30, 60, 30, 60, 80] on a win
motion.purpose: Where the browser supports vibration; silent on iOS.

motion.name: inicio-arrive
motion.value: host opacity 220ms; sides translateX from -60% / 60% with a 6px recoil at 60%, 480ms; VS scale 2 to 1 with opacity, 240ms after 260ms; band translateY 12px with opacity, 240ms after 200ms
motion.purpose: Inicio arriving mid-session: the two sides slam in and meet at the VS. Nothing at launch.

motion.name: inicio-leave
motion.value: host opacity to 0, 220ms; sides translateX to -40% / 40%, 220ms (animate.leave)
motion.purpose: Inicio leaving as a match starts: the sides part while the board beneath, already live, plays the match start.

motion.name: band-light
motion.value: white at 22% across the band, linear-gradient 100deg, 2.4s ease-in-out infinite after 600ms
motion.purpose: The light that crosses the "Partida rápida" band, as on the match point stripe.

breakpoints.name: short
breakpoints.purpose: Compact layout for a phone on its side or large text on a small phone: strip lockup, 48-pixel slabs, 56-pixel number fields, no triple-slash mark in overlays, compact winner screen, tighter screen bar and footer, seat slabs without a minimum height, champion name in Title size, and at Inicio a 112px grid with the letter beside "Equipo" and 48px choices without their second lines.

breakpoints.name: short-wide
breakpoints.purpose: On a short screen with room across: the header's status line between the target slab and the menu control, quick-points beside Anotar, points remaining beside the total, winner actions, screen footer actions, menu entries and seat slabs side by side, and the two choices at Inicio side by side, with "Personalizar" for "Personalizar partida".

mediaFeatures.name: prefers-color-scheme: light
mediaFeatures.purpose: Read only by script, as the answer for the "Sistema" appearance choice. Styles look at data-scheme="light" on the root element, which swaps the neutral, danger, scrim and team-edge tokens to the day appearance and turns the sheet's triple-slash mark to Text colour.

mediaFeatures.name: prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference
mediaFeatures.purpose: The only context in which animations and transitions are declared.

mediaFeatures.name: hover: hover
mediaFeatures.purpose: Hover brightening is limited to devices with a real pointer.

mediaFeatures.name: max-height: 36em
mediaFeatures.purpose: The short-screen layout; em-based, so it follows the reader's font size.

mediaFeatures.name: pointer: coarse
mediaFeatures.purpose: Read only by script, once, on launch: a device with a coarse pointer starts as touch, so a screen that opens by itself draws no focus ring.

shape.renderer: CSS. A ::before layer behind the content with transform: skewX(-12deg), filled by --fill and bordered by --edge (.lean in src/styles.css); clip-path polygons for the liveries and the slash mark. Content is never skewed.
shape.iconStroke: 2px on every icon, round caps and joins, 24 grid

layout.viewport: 100dvh column, max-width 480px, centred; body does not scroll
layout.safeArea: top inset above the header and above a screen bar; bottom inset under the quick bar, sheet panels, screen footers and winner screen
layout.keyboard: --keyboard-inset is set on the root element from window.visualViewport; sheets anchor their bottom edge to it
layout.shortScreens: at max-height 36em the same parts tighten; at min-width 30em as well, stacked pairs sit side by side. The column stays 480px. No rule is keyed to a narrow width.
layout.list: follows a new hand to the end; other changes leave the scroll position, unless the undo bar arrives within 80px of the end
layout.screens: full-screen dialog in three bands inside the 480px column: bar (back control and title), scrolling body, pinned footer under a 1px hairline. A locked screen has no back control.
layout.header: target slab at the left and one 48px menu control at the right; in a tournament the status line wraps under them, full width less 16px at the right, and sits between them on a short wide screen; at Inicio the app's name (triple-slash mark 22 and "Dominó" in Title, 48px tall) stands in for the target slab
layout.inicio: in-page layer over the board while nothing is being played (not a dialog; the board is inert beneath it), Ground colour, 480px column: the board's header with the brand; the two liveries as one button filling the flexible height (min 172px), VS on the seam, the "Partida rápida" band 24px from each side and 16px above their foot; the facts line (12px above, 24px sides, 16px below); two outlined choices 64px tall, 12px apart, pinned under a 1px Line hairline. Short: grid min 112px, letter beside "Equipo" in Title, VS in Title at 40%, band 48px, choices 48px without their second lines; short-wide: choices side by side, "Personalizar" for "Personalizar partida".

focus.touch: :root[data-input='touch'] hides the ring on everything except input; focus is not moved. Tab or an arrow key sets data-input='keyboard'. A device with a coarse pointer starts as touch.

overrides.main: no ring; it only receives focus from script after an undo
overrides.textField: offset 0, so the ring never covers the label; underline turns to text colour

timing.undoSingleHand: 8000ms for a deleted, corrected or quick-added hand; paused while hovered or focused
timing.undoBoard: every offer to undo lasts 3 seconds, paused while the bar is hovered or focused; nothing is kept across a restart; a board-wide offer also ends when the board changes
timing.undoHistory: No time limit for a deleted match or tournament or a cleared history, until another undo takes its place or the app is closed. Full screens offer only these.

playerPair.wrap: flex-wrap; the second name moves under the first
playerPair.overflow: each name on one line, ending in an ellipsis when it alone does not fit
playerPair.separator: a middle dot that belongs to the first name

narrative.overview:
The scoreboard is painted like two rival race cars parked nose to nose. Each team owns a flood of one loud colour with its total set in numerals large enough to read from the far seat at the table, and every other surface steps back to graphite at night or pit silver by day. There is one board, and while nothing is being played Inicio lies over it: the two liveries lined up nose to nose, which are the quick match. Above them sit twelve bottom sheets (menu, points, settings, reset, team, seat, name, team picker, statistics filter, removing a mesa, end of tournament, clearing the history), twelve full screens (history, match, tournament record, personalised match, tournament setup, next match, standings, champion, mesas, mesa, statistics, player statistics) and the winner screen, all built from the same parts.

The system has one shape and one typeface. The shape is a parallelogram that leans 12 degrees forward, used for buttons, rows, list entries, chips, the two liveries, the seat and champion slabs, the undo bar and the full-screen floods. The typeface is Kanit, set in heavy italic capitals for everything that is a name, a number or a command, and in upright medium only for full sentences. The only ornament is a mark of three small leaning bars cut from the same shape.

Density is low and the targets are large: the smallest control is 48 pixels and slab buttons are 56 pixels tall (48 on a short screen). The board has no navigation bar and no tabs: one menu button in the header opens a sheet that leads to everything that is not scoring, and a full screen returns through its back control. There are no cards, and the icons are a few small line symbols. On a wide screen the same phone column sits centred on the ground, 480 pixels wide.
keyCharacteristics: Two saturated team colours used as fills, always carrying graphite ink.
One forward-leaning parallelogram as the shape of every filled element; zero corner radius anywhere.
Kanit extra-bold italic capitals with tabular numerals; hull-sized totals at 4.75rem.
Flat tonal layering on a single ground colour per appearance.
Brief motion, 200 to 220 ms, exponential ease-out, entering from the side that owns it; all of it removed under reduced motion.
Spanish interface copy throughout, in the informal second person, with short imperative commands.

rules.name: The Livery Rule
rules.body: A team colour is a fill. It carries Graphite Ink and never prints as text on the ground or on a surface.

rules.name: The Seat Rule
rules.body: In a tournament a team colour belongs to a side of the board, not to a team: the left seat is Safety Orange and the right seat is Acid Yellow, and a team wears the colour of the seat it takes. A champion is shown in the colour of the side it last won on, and in Text colour when there is none.

rules.name: The Graphite Exception Rule
rules.body: A team colour prints as text only on a Graphite Ink fill: the rounds chip inside each livery, the wins chip on a seat slab, the "Ganador" chip on the side of a finished match, the winner's slab on the winner screen and the champion slab on its own flood.

rules.name: The Same Ink Rule
rules.body: Ink on a team colour is Graphite Ink in both appearances. It does not invert when the ground does.

rules.name: The Day Keyline Rule
rules.body: By day every team-colour fill on the ground or a surface wears a 2-pixel Graphite Ink keyline: liveries, points chips, team slabs, seat slabs, the sides of a finished match, and the champion slab and chip. At night the keyline has no width. The winner flood and the flood of a screen never wear one.

rules.name: The Danger Rule
rules.body: Danger means an invalid value or an action that deletes or ends what was being kept. Outlined in Danger on the ground, a slab leads to deleting or ending; filled with Danger, it is the action that does it. It is never decoration and never a team.

rules.name: The Caps Italic Rule
rules.body: Names, numbers and commands are italic capitals. Upright sentence case is reserved for full sentences: explanations, errors, notices and the undo message.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every numeral that can change is set with tabular figures so totals and columns do not shift as they update.

rules.name: The Hull Cap Rule
rules.body: Type is sized in rem and follows the reader's font size, up to a pixel cap written into each token as `min(rem, px)`. Text stops at 1.6 times its designed size (Title, Button, Compact, Body, Meta, Label). Numerals and the winner heading stop at 1.2 times (Winner, Hull, Display, Field), because they are already large and must stay on one line.

rules.name: The One Line Rule
rules.body: Totals, team names, slab labels, screen titles, the header's status line and the winner heading shrink to fit their box on one line rather than wrap or truncate. They never shrink below 0.5 of their designed size, and never below 12 pixels, the smallest type that can still be read at the table; the winner's total and the labels of a choice group may go to 0.4, above the same 12 pixels. The fit leaves 4% of slack, because letter-spacing does not shrink with the type, and only the width is clipped, so tall glyphs such as an opening exclamation mark stay whole. A players line is never shrunk: it wraps, as described under Components.

rules.name: The Tonal Step Rule
rules.body: A surface is distinguished from what is beneath it by stepping one neutral tone, never by a shadow or a gradient. The newest row is marked by moving from Surface to Raised Surface. A selected row takes the same step and adds a 2-pixel Text colour keyline, and so do the rows that lead a ranking. In the history a tournament sits on Raised Surface among matches on Surface.

rules.name: The Lean Rule
rules.body: Every filled shape is the 12-degree parallelogram. Skew the layer behind the content, or cut it; never skew, rotate or round the element that holds the text.

rules.name: The One Ornament Rule
rules.body: The triple-slash mark is the only decoration. It is hidden from assistive technology.

dos: Do draw every filled shape as the 12-degree parallelogram (offset = height × 0.2126), leaning the same way as the italic type: a skewed layer behind the content, or a clip-path cut where the lean is a fixed distance.
Do inset the leaning layer by half its lean so the slanted ends stay inside the element's box.
Do put Graphite Ink on Safety Orange and Acid Yellow in both appearances.
Do give every team-colour fill on the ground or a surface the 2-pixel Graphite Ink keyline by day.
Do give a team the colour of the side it sits on in a tournament, and a champion the colour of the side it last won on, or Text colour when there is none.
Do set names, numbers and commands in Kanit italic capitals, and keep upright sentence case for full sentences.
Do use tabular numerals for any number that updates.

Do size type in rem with a pixel cap: 1.6 times for text, 1.2 times for numerals and the winner heading. Let one-line text shrink to fit, never below 12 pixels, and let a players line wrap instead of shrinking.
Do keep every target at least 48 pixels and slab buttons at least 56 tall; on a short screen slabs may drop to 48, never lower.
Do outline in Danger the action that leads to deleting or ending, and fill with Danger the one that does it.
Do mark state by stepping a neutral tone (Surface to Raised Surface), by adding a Text colour keyline, or by swapping fill and outline.

Do give every interactive element the 3-pixel focus ring, in a colour that contrasts with the surface it sits on and drawn wholly on that surface. After a touch, withhold the ring but leave focus where it is; text fields always keep theirs.
Do bring things in from the side or edge that owns them, in 200 to 220 ms with the exponential ease-out, and declare the movement only when reduced motion is not requested.
Do keep text fields, the sheet panel and the full screen rectangular.
Do keep sheets above the on-screen keyboard and inside the 480 column, and full screens inside the same column.
Do pin a screen's actions in its footer and let only its body scroll.
Do tighten the same parts when the viewport is 36em tall or less, with thresholds in em, and keep the actions of every overlay on screen.
Do keep what is about to change in view while its options are showing, and put each explanation directly under the action it explains.
Do give any gesture-only shortcut a visible control that reaches the same value.
donts: Don't print a team colour as text on the ground or on a neutral surface; it is only legible as text on a Graphite Ink fill.
Don't round a corner. No radius exists in this system.
Don't skew or rotate the element that holds text. The layer behind it leans; the italic does the rest.
Don't add shadows, gradients or blur to slabs, rows, chips, liveries, fields or sheets.
Don't invert the ink on team colours in the day appearance.
Don't use Danger for anything other than an invalid value or an action that deletes or ends.
